constraints: Simulate noisy concentration-time data at five temperatures spanning a 10-fold range of k, with known A and Ea.
Sampling times run from 0 to 3/k at each temperature.
Noise is additive Gaussian of a stated size.
Fit k at each temperature by nonlinear least squares.
Fit ln k against 1/T with centred 1/T, weighting each point by the variance of its ln k.
One Python script using numpy (and scipy where it helps), with matplotlib (Agg backend).
Two or three figures that answer the question directly, each with the reference or theory value drawn.
A short paper of at most 4 pages.
Cite only sources actually found and read; say so if a reference cannot be confirmed.
CPU only; under 60 seconds of runtime.
Use fixed random seeds where the run is random, and state them in the paper.
Report every number with its uncertainty (for a deterministic result, its numerical error).
Say when a result is only a check of the code.
